notes.1: the dissolve has ended; the man holds the binoculars to his eyes, tilted a little to his left
notes.8: he begins to tip his head back to look higher; the camera tilts up with him
notes.13: the binoculars come level and sink in the frame
notes.22: the binoculars tilt slightly the other way

no_cel: SAM followed the binoculars for frames 0 to 8 and then the man's hands, so cel paint from the silhouette would cover the hands and not the binoculars
people_note: hand_l, hand_r, arms and head are repeated once per frame, each visible on its own frame: the hands and chin are placed with the binoculars' centre in the cast, and the arms bend from the hands (with the binoculars) to the elbows and shoulders (with the measured camera). Before this they slid with the camera alone, drifting left while the binoculars drifted right, so the hands slid against the barrels. Regenerate after the cast changes.
